answer: Each identity is a vertex sponsored into a committed on-chain tree, posting a saffron bond of staked capital. When settlement proves one clone a sybil, slashing cascades downward through every vertex below its sponsors, burning the whole garden of descendants. A farm planting N clones under shared sponsors risks all N bonds at once, so capital-at-risk grows with subtree volume O(n); each added fake enlarges what one detection destroys. Clones cannot re-parent, and spreading under N honest sponsors needs N outsiders willing to burn their own garden, a scarce tie no coalition mints per clone.
